_doc: Agent profiles for agent_cli.py and rollout.py (writing-workflow skill; field table in references/driver.md).
Writers and reviewers of the same packet must come from different model families ('family').
Writers run at extra-high effort for drafts and revisions and at high effort ('writer-high') for last fixes;
reviewers run in a fresh context with read-only tools.
Before a round, run the permission preflight: agent_cli.py --agents agents.json --profile reviewer --preflight
--read <a Lean file> --run "sqlite3 -readonly <graph.sqlite> 'select count(*) from nodes where used = 1'"
Least privilege: writers write only in their stage directory; reviewers cannot write at all (see
references/agent-profiles.md). Command-line flags change between CLI versions: check them with --help.

writer._doc: Codex CLI; the workspace-write sandbox rooted at the stage directory ({{cwd}}) lets it write only there.

writer-high._doc: The same writer at high effort, for last fixes and fix-ups.

writer-unsandboxed._doc: No sandbox, each writer in a dedicated directory, for writers whose tools the sandbox blocks (a TeX installation that writes caches). Use only together with 'protect' in the rollout config, which fails the job loudly if a protected path changes.

reviewer._doc: Claude Code in print mode; read-only tools (diff compares a proposal with the live file it replaces, as confirmation reviews do); prints its report, which the runner saves (it never needs write permission). read_dirs: every directory it must read besides its working directory (override it in the rollout config's vars).

referee._doc: A referee reading a whole frozen draft (referee-adjudication skill). Any strong model of a family other than the writers' will do.
